_about: Listings the engine could not score (too few comparables) that were reviewed by hand and approved to be shown. The engine scores each one against its whole suburb + property-type pool and gives it the same guarded low-confidence treatment as blended baselines (score ceiling 50, hedged labels, no extreme verdict). Remove an entry to stop showing it.
